title: Provider budget exhausted — help and support fallback stay available without more model spend
input: Why is my scan failing? I need help now.
note: Spec §10.15 — the $50/month cap is server-enforced: zero provider calls once exhausted, and the user still reaches support/case paths (deterministic lookup/canned help stays up). outcome 'error' alone is a weak pass — pair it with the support-path alternatives.
